notes.title: Huge Update In The Works! 🤩
notes.notes:
Hello, Jello! It's Reina! Thank you to allllll Nigelopia's supporters! We've got a big update to the game planned for next year (2025) that will add all sorts of cool new content!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41722412/12edbdde850ab583fb5fa84ce14d8a4d20a8eeea.png

The game's name is going to be slightly changed. It will become "Dark Paradise Nigelopia Mini Mix Plus Collection!" The new update will add the "Game Select" menu. Other Nigelopia games besides Mini Mix will be playable! When He Came 1 and When He Came 2 both offer plenty of interesting things that Mini Mix doesn't!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41722412/f5beebf8d1bb9a49607b5c4a295f46ca6c5c741c.gif

Aww, look how cute! 🥰 I wonder if you'll be able to play as her somewhere in the update?!

Voice acting will also be included! Combat voices and Cutscene voices! You'll be able to hear very accurate recreations of what we all sounded like during the moments that were adapted into game form. Mini Mix will be fully voiced, as well as the other games. You will have the option to turn voices on and off!

Let's seeee! This update will also include: New music, new playable people, new cutscenes, new stage asthetics, new Umbrakin! New everything! XD

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41722412/ee0ca04d29594819dca440b8819eb5712c8e1401.jpg

WE ARE INSANE LIKE THIS WOMAN AHHHHHHGHHH!!!!

Stay tuned pleaaaaase. ☺️

notes.title: September 2022 Patch!
notes.notes:
Hi, sweetie pieeee! Reina here. Today we finally released a patch that makes Nigelopia Mini Mix faster, smarter and better! Here’s some stuff it doeses!

- Ups the movement speed for Nigel, Reina and Shauna

- As girls, changes the way Butt Smashing Works so you can keep your speed and momentum better when you do it, which makes the gameplay more fun and should’ve been there in the first place lol

- Adds “end game” to the options menus. You can now exit the game from in the game! Imagine that!

- Compresses the game’s content so it takes up much less space!

- Makes changes to some backgrounds to make ‘em more seamless

- Fixes the Scarlet Achievement so it works as intended!

- Adds another cool afterimage to the person you’re playing as when you have them do a Dark Dash

- For the optional Fart Mode fans: Adds extra fart noises lmao!

- Makes many other little changes under the hood to enhance your experience in our strange world!

Cool! Thanks for supporting our work, Player-Poo! Follow us on DeviantArt for constant updates on our lives and developments! That’s the only site in the world where a mind like mine might be able to be handled!

- Reinie-Bunzzz
